author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the 1980s, my family sometimes visited my uncle and aunt's home on top of a mountain in Oregon. Their neighbourhood was full of fragrant bark mulch. I watched MTV, a music video channel that we did not have in BC, on their television. Music videos were like haiku for my generation. The Grotto, a Roman Catholic shrine, was a nice visit on top of a mountain. There were gardens and statues.

jyutping: hai2 1980 nin4 doi6，ngo5 uk1 kei2 jan4 jau5 si4 wui5 heoi3 ngo5 suk1 suk1 tung4 ji1 ji1 hai2 ngo4 lak6 gong1 zau1 jat1 zo6 saan1 deng2 ge3 uk1 kei2。keoi5 dei6 go3 leon4 geoi1 cung1 mun5 zo2 hoeng1 nung4 ge3 syu6 pei4 fuk1 koi3 mat6。ngo5 hai2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 din6 si6 dou6 tai2 zo2 MTV ，jat1 go3 ngo5 dei6 hai2 BC mou5 ge3 jam1 ngok6 si6 pan4 pan4 dou6。deoi3 ngo5 ni1 go3 sai3 doi6 lai4 gong2，jam1 ngok6 si6 pan4 zau6 hou2 ci5 paai4 geoi3 gam2。sek6 fat1，hai6 jat1 go3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 ge3 san4 se5，hai6 jat1 go3 hai2 saan1 deng2 soeng6 ge3 hou2 heoi3 cyu3。go2 dou6 jau5 faa1 jyun2 tung4 diu1 zoeng6。
text: 喺1980年代，我屋企人有時會去我叔叔同姨姨喺俄勒岡州一座山頂嘅屋企。佢哋個鄰居充滿咗香濃嘅樹皮覆蓋物。我喺佢哋嘅電視度睇咗 MTV ，一個我哋喺 BC 冇嘅音樂視頻頻道。對我呢個世代嚟講，音樂視頻就好似俳句噉。石窟，係一個羅馬天主教嘅神社，係一個喺山頂上嘅好去處。嗰度有花園同雕像。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's the 18th of May of 2025. About 15:00, I went walking to Tim Hortons café to enjoy an Earl Grey Tea with oat milk. In my outing, I was thinking about the Next Great War scenario versus the Singularitarianism scenario, as a plausible future. Personally, I opine that widespread war destruction would be less appealing than the transcendence of intelligence, even if it might mean something superseding humanity. At the café were handsome athletic Latino-looking men. The clouds started pervading the sky again. I saw my neighbour friend Rod wiping his camper's back side, at which, he said, UV rays are more intense, as the logo and words imprinted are starting to fade.

jyutping: ji4 gaa1 hai6 2025 nin4 5 jyut6 18 hou6。daai6 joek3 3 dim2，ngo5 heoi3 zo2 haang4 heoi3 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 teng1，jam2 zo2 jat1 bui1 pui3 jin3 mak6 naai5 ge3 baak3 zoek3 caa4。hai2 ngo5 ge3 gaau1 jau4 jap6 min6，ngo5 nam2 gan2 haa6 jat1 coeng4 daai6 zin3 ge3 cing4 fong3 deoi3 daan1 jat1 zyu2 ji6 ge3 cing4 fong3，zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 ho2 seon3 ge3 mei6 loi4。ngo5 go3 jan4 jing6 wai4，gwong2 faan6 ge3 zin3 zang1 po3 waai6 wui5 bei2 hei2 ciu1 jyut6 zi3 lik6 gang3 mou5 kap1 jan5 lik6，zau6 syun3 ni1 go3 ho2 nang4 ji3 mei6 zyu6 jat1 di1 ceoi2 doi6 jan4 leoi6 ge3 je5。hai2 gaa3 fe1 teng1 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 leng3 zai2，jau5 wan6 dung6 jing4 ge3 laai1 ding1 jeoi6 naam4 jan2。di1 wan4 jau6 hoi1 ci2 pin3 bou3 tin1 hung1。ngo5 gin3 dou2 ngo5 leon4 geoi1 pang4 jau5 Rod mut3 gan2 keoi5 gaa3 lou6 jing4 ce1 ge3 hau6 min6，keoi5 waa6 hai2 ni1 go3 si4 hau6，zi2 ngoi6 sin3 wui5 gang3 gaa1 koeng4 lit6，jan1 wai6 jan3 zo2 ge3 biu1 zi3 tung4 zi6 ngaan5 hoi1 ci2 teoi3 sik1。
text: 而家係2025年5月18號。大約3點，我去咗行去 Tim Hortons 咖啡廳，飲咗一杯配燕麥奶嘅伯爵茶。喺我嘅郊遊入面，我諗緊下一場大戰嘅情況對單一主義嘅情況，作為一個可信嘅未來。我個人認為，廣泛嘅戰爭破壞會比起超越智力更冇吸引力，就算呢個可能意味住一啲取代人類嘅嘢。喺咖啡廳入面有啲靚仔，有運動型嘅拉丁裔男人。啲雲又開始遍佈天空。我見到我鄰居朋友 Rod 抹緊佢架露營車嘅後面，佢話喺呢個時候，紫外線會更加強烈，因為印咗嘅標誌同字眼開始褪色。
